text.title: Code Review Cycle Worked Example
text.summary: One end-to-end worked example for Code Review Cycle: trigger fires, inputs gathered, artefact produced and validated against output contract.

example.title: Happy-path application
example.trigger: Operator opens calendar slot named in Applies If; preconditions are met.
example.validation: Run scripts/validate-code-review-cycle.py against the produced artefact. Expected exit 0 (ok).
example.downstream: Artefact handed off to the consumers named in Related; outcome reviewed at next iteration.

example.title: Un-anchored application
example.trigger: Operator skipped Applies If gate; preconditions not verified.
example.inputs: Free-text prose substitutes; no cited evidence.
example.validation: Validator returns non-zero with violation list per forbidden patterns in content/02-output-contract.xml.
example.downstream: Artefact rejected; consumers do not read; operator reruns with full preconditions.

example.title: SDD task completion checkpoints
example.code: task_completion: self_review: - "All acceptance criteria met" - "AI review passed (no critical issues)" - "Tests added and passing" pr_review: - "Design doc alignment verified" - "Traceability links correct" - "No SDD deviations (or documented)"
example.note: These checkpoints are embedded in the task file, not left as implicit expectations. Required by r9-sdd-two-checkpoints.

example.title: Reflexion block
example.code: reflexion: patterns_learned: - "What review patterns caught issues?" - "What did AI miss that humans caught?" improvements: - "Update AI rules for missed issues?" - "Add to self-review checklist?"
example.note: Answered after every merge per r10-post-merge-reflexion; the answers are what r4-reflexion-writeback writes to patterns.md and mistakes.md.
